_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: Other months / question punctuation ↔ January–February (early year)
axes.rationale: All three lenses put ' January', 'February', ' Jan', 'bruary' and 'vier' at the positive end. The negative end is mostly noise, apart from the Jacobian lens's '?\n'-type punctuation and faint autumn fragments ('/oct', 'tember').

axes.label: Winter months (Nov–Feb) ↔ summer months (Aug–Sep)
axes.rationale: The negative end is dominated by ' January', ' December', ' November', ' February' and '冬' (winter) across all lenses. The positive end has ' Summer', 'summer', ' Sommer', '夏' (summer), '-Aug' and '-Sep', which reads as the seasonal opposite on the month circle.

axes.label: Autumn months (Sep–Oct) / years ↔ question/list punctuation
axes.rationale: The Jacobian negative end shows ' September', ' October', ' Oktober', ' oct' and year prefixes ('199', '198', '200'), and '/oct' also appears in the logit and tuned lenses. The positive end is '?\n' and ' etc' punctuation, while the remaining logit and tuned tokens are noise.
